To express the number in Cartesian form, we expand the parentheses and substitute the values of the cosine and sine.

Since $\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2})=0$ and $\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2})=-1$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =3(\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2})+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2})) \\  & =3(0-\text{i}) \\  & =-3\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
